content: {"question":"After a new GitLab employee relocates from Quebec to another province, what token of acknowledgement do they receive on their first hire‑date anniversary and where are they mentioned?","answer":"They receive a token of acknowledgement and are mentioned in the #team‑member‑updates channel.","evidence_a":"At GitLab we like to acknowledge and celebrate team member milestones and contributions. This means that those celebrating their first, third, fifth and tenth hire‑date anniversary will receive a token of acknowledgement.","evidence_b":"Along with this, all celebrants regardless of length of tenure will receive a mention in the #team‑member‑updates channel which allows the greater GitLab community to share in the celebration!"}
